rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: STACK is a runtime control plane for AI agents that provides security and observability across agent workflows. It offers scoped short-lived credentials, server-side credential injection, real-time behavioral detectors, tamper-evident audit logs, and sub-60-second access revocation. EU-hosted with OAuth on first call and support for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, and Cursor.
